title: Comparison record can overwrite an entry certificate and break error finalisation
description:

The new error-path refresh at src/main.rs:806-807 then raises KeyError: producer before report::failure, masking the native-link error and leaving the launch receipt hash invalid. This is an inherited alias-admission hole exposed by the new receipt-refresh interaction, not a newly claimed baseline regression. Reviewed head: 9104bb98e95a34c9404585303cd4c8ed9b472af8.

title: pin-driver review P0: SYSROOT environment configuration silently uses host headers
description:
The newly advertised BENNETT_DRIVER_SYSROOT is ignored by production compilation and native linking, so an environment-configured build can complete using host headers and produce a different result from the equivalent --bennett-sysroot flag. Reviewed head 8208879ce127fe90eb1a950062c562642d9e0828.

Locations: src/main.rs:22 advertises SYSROOT; src/main.rs:405-407 sysroot_flags only reads Options; src/main.rs:541 calls it. src/native_host.rs:56 and src/native.rs:474 likewise only consume the flag. The configured_path helper at src/main.rs:250 does not normalize the env into Options. Existing tests/toolchain.py:17-20 sets the sysroot environment value without testing its effect on production.

Reproduced from bennett-driver-job-pin, with DISPLAY/WAYLAND_DISPLAY/DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS/BROWSER unset and the review TMPDIR/CARGO_TARGET_DIR:
  timeout 240 cargo test --offline -j3 --test pin_discipline --bin bennett-driver -- --nocapture --test-threads=4
passes (6 unit tests and all 10 Python pin cases), yet this independent probe exposes the bug:

  timeout 60 python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, 'tests')

configure(23)
exe = pathlib.Path('.tmp/rev-pin-driver-r1/target/debug/bennett-driver').resolve()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=os.environ['TMPDIR']) as tmp:
    d = pathlib.Path(tmp)

title: Missing input target triple and layout silently inherit runtime settings
description:
Reviewed range: 08e6b9983..64bd6d7a053c269db8e4548a88625e9b6f762c59. Reviewer: gpt-6.1-sol xhigh under R14. No fixes made. 

src/main.rs:494 only compares target headers when present; it never requires each input to provide both. Pinned dialect 0.2.10 section 19.8 requires one target triple and datalayout per input with BD-E-VERSION otherwise. Missing values silently inherit the runtime target at llvm-link, rather than producing the required version error.

Repro run: timeout 240 python3 .tmp/rev-driver/repro.py core. headers-absent.ll defines marked top plus native main with neither target header; layout-absent.ll supplies only target triple. Require both headers independently for every input before linking.

title: fat-object: Bind module launches to program-scoped budgets handles and history
description:
Determining evidence: The driver forwards build-time budget/disk/entry options, records artifacts, writes replay-style argv replies and reports compilation completion. It does not load a program or call run/wait/reply/reverse/close; there is no implemented native caller adapter here. Thus a compiled launch is not evidence that a native host can suspend, service a request, resume or reverse a selected module. There is also no driver code casting qreg/token handles to pointers; absence of the adapter must not be misreported as an existing handle-representation bug.

Keep R effect tapes and invocation-tree history owned by the run; do not reset them during each module call. Respect run states, exclusive memory/register ownership until CLOSED and reverse eligibility before host mutation/reuse. Choose/document whether compatible modules link into one program or load as separate programs; never conflate handle namespaces or put runtime mutable state into object identity. Distinguish compile-complete from linked/loaded/executed evidence.

Contract/coordination: ISA10 already specifies these handles, copying, states and ownership. No wholesale launch ABI invention is needed. Missing outer binding/context/service conventions must be published; no new host-memory-by-reference or tape mechanism is authorised by this audit.
